content: Do not subtract initial holder world-X displacement directly from a socket-X correction without a validated frame/response mapping. This attempt produced about−1.498mm precontact residual and failed seating.
applicability: Original Piper MuJoCo workcell, holder +1.5mm, strip yaw about−89.55deg; native program replans IK
embodiment: Current dual Piper simulation, privileged object poses; not real calibration
known_limits: Correct replacement not yet tested at same +1.5mm initial condition
Not evidence for changed real extrinsics
